newsitem.title: USA: PAR restates Q2 shr loss to $0.59 from $0.64.
newsitem.headline: PAR restates Q2 shr loss to $0.59 from $0.64.

text.p: PAR Technology Corp said Wednesday it is restating its second quarter loss per share to $0.59 from $0.64.
The company said this change is a result of an agreement it signed with Phoenix Systems & Technologies Inc concerning funds owned to Rome Research Corp, a wholly owned subsidiary of PAR.

The signing of this agreement alters PAR's second quarter results favorably by $464,000 after tax or $0.05 per share. The $464,000 was previously included in a one time charge taken in the second quarter.
The company said it had been in negotiations for some time with Phoenix Systems, and didn't expect an impending agreement when it released second quarter earnings on July 17.
But the company said it reached an agreement with Phoenix Systems on July 29, requiring adjustment to the previously announced results.

The agreement with Phoenix Systems included cash payments totaling $720,000, or $464,000 after tax. It also provides for additional payments during a three year period, and the elimination of PAR's $900,000 loan guarantee for Phoenix Systems.

However, the company said the majority of the payments and the relief of the loan guarantee are subject to Phoenix Systems obtaining additional bank financing. The company said Phoenix Systems expects a decision from the bank in the third quarter.
PAR said a successful financing effort by Phoenix Systems would result in the reversal of additional reserves.
In addition, PAR said the agreement has resulted in it halting all litigation efforts for the remaining amounts owed by Phoenix Systems.
